note: BH-1141 phase 1. Every place this fleet invokes a model, fleet-wide — bin/, cron/, checks/, fly/ and skills/, the roots tests/llm-call-ratchet-test.sh scans. THE POINT: bin/agent-call.sh is meant to be the one choke point where a model call can be seen, priced and stopped, and this file is the census that says where that is true and where it is not. `through_agent_call: false` is the leak list. This catalog is the SOURCE and the only committed half: docs/LLM_CALL_SITES.md is rendered from it by bin/llm-sites-build.sh and is git-ignored (BH-1268), so an edit here needs no regenerated doc in the same commit — CI, the share mirror and every box render it. tests/llm-call-ratchet-test.sh holds the line. KIND IS THE SHAPE OF THE SITE, and it must never disagree with `through_agent_call`: `choke-point` is bin/agent-call.sh itself, `agent-call` goes through it (so BH-1141's gate can refuse it), `claude-cost` goes through bin/claude-cost.sh (priced, and gated by the same llm-gate and K3 before claude starts, BH-2534), and `raw-vendor` reaches a vendor CLI or API directly. LINE NUMBERS ARE DELIBERATELY ABSENT: every site carries a `marker` (a literal that must still be in the script) instead, because a checked-in line number drifts on every edit to an unrelated part of the file and would make this inventory a daily source of main-red rather than a record.
